row: Listening and signing up ask for no crypto-asset, by Audius's own pages. The wallet is optional.
sticker.back: What it is: Audius, a music streaming service where artists upload tracks, built on an open protocol. What you hold: an account; a wallet only if you choose. What you give up: a handle never changes; Audius cannot recover a lost wallet. The wrong idea: that you need crypto to listen. Named as an example, not a recommendation. Checked 2026-11-23.
